description: This file implements a Timer plugin for the WPEFramework, providing timer management functionalities such as start, cancel, suspend, resume, and status reporting. It includes methods for handling timer events, callbacks, and communication with external systems via IARM and CEC.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A plugin class managing timers, handling timer lifecycle, notifications, and external communication.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up IARM communication.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deinitializes IARM communication.

methods.name: checkTimers
methods.description: Checks and updates the status of all active timers.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: cancelTimer
methods.description: Cancels a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: suspendTimer
methods.description: Suspends a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: onTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer fires, handling expiration and reminders.

methods.name: getTimerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specified timer.

methods.name: startTimerWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for starting a timer via JSON RPC.

methods.name: cancelWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for canceling a timer via JSON RPC.

methods.name: suspendWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for suspending a timer via JSON RPC.

methods.name: resumeWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for resuming a suspended timer via JSON RPC.

methods.name: getTimerStatusWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving timer status via JSON RPC.

methods.name: getTimersWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving all timers via JSON RPC.

methods.name: sendTimerExpired
methods.description: Sends notification and external signals when a timer expires.

methods.name: sendTimerExpiryReminder
methods.description: Sends reminder notifications before timer expiration.
